study_goal: Separately identify visits to a recipient breeding area, initiation of an egg/nest after that visit, and subsequent chick success within the SAME marked adults, location and season, not from selected nests or at-sea positions alone.

sources.date_scope: 1977–2017 parent archival set; focal camera network ~2015–2017
sources.focal_selection_condition: Nests selected when at least TWO adults were visible at an EMPTY nest bowl prior to egg-laying (Hinke et al 2018 Methods Ecol Evol doi 10.1111/2041-210X.13015)

attendance_codebook.0: no adult observed at PRESELECTED focal nest on observation date, NOT breeding-site zero population
attendance_codebook.4: creche observed, TERMINAL STATUS NOT four adults
attendance_codebook.5: confirmed nest failure, TERMINAL STATUS NOT five adults

sources.observation_not_collected: all adults visiting colony before nest initiation, unselected nonbreeders or marked first attempts at each arrival

sites: Henryk Arktowski Station, King George Island
sources.unit: individual PTT Argos at-sea dated longitude/latitude, quality, underwater proportion
sources.observation_not_collected: marked colony-return event, exact nest-first-egg event, directly observed subsequent reproductive success

sources.grains: adult Argos telemetry locations during previously labelled incubation/brood/creche or overwinter deployments
sources.selection_condition: already breeding-stage tagged, not a source of individual nonbreeding-to-egg transitions

peer_review_prior_art: Hinke et al 2018 already fitted nest attendance switches and extracted clutch initiation/creche as a method and its 2015/16 application
Lowther et al 2022 tracked 30 nonbreeding adults and already studied their foraging ranges vs breeders in western Antarctic Peninsula
Southwell and Emmerson 2015 and 2015 PLOS One showed abundance/detection errors from colonially attending nonbreeders
Ross Island Dugger et al 2026 already reported first recruitment by age and breeder movement

identifiability_conditions.target_estimand: P(egg initiation by same marked bird before end of season | that individual attended candidate recipient site at date d)
identifiability_conditions.data_requirement_sampling_denominator: All or detection-adjusted at-risk prospective adult arrivals including those not paired and those that never nest
identifiability_conditions.data_requirement_stage_eggs: Observed egg date at identified individual; not a nesting pair/nest camera only
identifiability_conditions.data_requirement_origin: natal/previous colony and age of visitor before arrival
identifiability_conditions.data_requirement_detection: effort correction for zero sightings/unknown days at non-selected area
